bootstrap.method: circular moving-block bootstrap of weekly trade sums and counts

discovery_selection_rule: At least 100 discovery closes and PF>=1.00 at modeled 2 bps; pick highest discovery PF@2 bps. Forward/OOS do not select the candidate.
forward_acceptance_rule: At least 30 forward closes, PF>=1.15 at modeled 1 and 2 bps, every qualifying annual cohort with at least 5 trades PF>=1 at 1 bp, and Holm-adjusted bootstrap p<0.05 for positive mean expectancy.
